no-var  This is a `var` declaration, which is function-scoped and hoisted rather than block-scoped. no-var  This is a `var` declaration, which is function-scoped and hoisted rather than block-scoped. A `var` in a loop is one binding shared by every iteration, which is why a closure created in the loop sees the final value rather than its own. Use `let`, or `const` when nothing reassigns it.
